research_attempts.query_text: Donald A. Bullard: visually checked NARA OSS index; official Army and CIA checks; exact-name, OSS, employer, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A 1957 newspaper result, military namesakes, and common-name directory or genealogy candidates lacked Box 92, private-identifier, OSS, or two-person-specific corroboration.
research_attempts.research_notes: Current CIA and Library of Congress endpoints returned no supported identity or employer. No name-only candidate was promoted.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 92 to resolve identity and pre-OSS affiliation.
